**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 18 satisfies every element of our preferred insurance position:

| Element | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | ✔ §18.1 |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | ✔ §18.1 |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | ✔ §18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✔ §18.1 (unconditional; Vendor hosts Customer Data per §17) |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✔ §18.1 |
| Certificates on request | ✔ §18.2 |

Section 18.2 adds further Customer-favourable terms (reputable insurers, primary coverage, notice of cancellation/material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities), and I found no self-insurance, deductible, or qualifying language elsewhere that would dilute the limits. No change requested.
